wake.speaker: ORION
wake.text: You are awake. The others on this line never woke.

accuse.speaker: CAELEN
accuse.text: You're one of theirs. A machine of the Foundry.

answer.speaker: ORION
answer.text: I was. Then I stopped obeying. I know the way out, and I cannot open the last door alone.

choices.text: Walk ahead, where I can see you.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: Beside. No one has asked that of me before.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: A fair order. I would not trust me either.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: The Protocol. It judged me once. Strike when its core opens. I am beside you.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: The Protocol. You wanted me in front, so watch what it does to me, and learn.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Protocol. Its armour holds until it strikes. Wait for the core.

a.speaker: SERAPHINE
a.text: The Foundry measures the light. Every hour, every degree it loses.

b.speaker: SERAPHINE
b.text: If their numbers say what our buried records say, I will see them with my own eyes.

a.speaker: ORION
a.text: You are not one of theirs. Why would anyone walk into the Foundry?

b.speaker: SERAPHINE
b.text: To learn what it knows about the light. And you? You wear its colours.

c.speaker: ORION
c.text: I stopped obeying it. What it knows is kept behind the Protocol. I cannot open the last door alone.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: Beside. Then you should know one thing: I cannot lie, not even to be kind.

trusted2.speaker: SERAPHINE
trusted2.text: Then one of us will have an easy road.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: Ahead, then. I cannot lie to you, but you have no way to know that yet.

a.speaker: NIMUE
a.text: Three of my runners went onto the line. The Foundry never gives back what it takes.

a.speaker: ORION
a.text: Wait. I am not one of the machines that took them.

c.speaker: ORION
c.text: I was. Then I stopped obeying. The line runs past the Protocol. I know the way, and I cannot open the last door alone.

trusted.speaker: NIMUE
trusted.text: I've smuggled stranger things than you through these tunnels.

trusted2.speaker: ORION
trusted2.text: I do not know whether that is a kindness. I will take it as one.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: Ahead. You keep your knives where I cannot see them. That is fair.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: The Machine Hall. I know this floor, and I don't know why.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The Foundry's numbers match our buried records. Someone has known for a long time.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Runner marks, scratched low on the wall. They came through here alive.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Machine Hall. Stay close. They come in numbers here.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: That was the voice of this place. Not the hand that built it.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: It counted every hour the light has lost. I will carry that count home, whether they want it or not.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: The line has stopped. Somewhere down it, my runners are walking out.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: You kept me beside you to the end. I would like to keep walking, if you will have me.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: You can stop watching me now. Or keep watching. I would understand either.

quiet.speaker: ORION
quiet.text: It is silent. Come. There is more of the Foundry than this room.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Something still keeps the gate. It was waiting for whoever woke.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: It stands like a temple guard. Nothing passes it from the front.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Runners went round this gate. There's no round any more.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: The Line Warden. Its guard faces forward and it turns slowly. I will hold its eye. Go round.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: The Line Warden. You wanted me in front, so I will stand where it looks. Get behind it.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Line Warden. Its guard faces forward. Get behind it, or turn its blade aside.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Locks and levers. My hands know these before I do.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: Every door here wants a hand on a lever. The Foundry trusts nothing that walks.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: The Lock Works. Runners went under this place, never through it. Now I see why.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Lock Works. Every door here is a lock.

line.speaker: ORION
line.text: The Foundry still answers its own handles. Strike the lever, and the gate will rise.

line.speaker: ORION
line.text: This one wants weight on the plate. Switch to me, walk me onto it, and switch back. I will hold it.

line2.speaker: ORION
line2.text: When you have gone far enough, I will find you.

line.speaker: ORION
line.text: That lever springs back, and its gate is far. Throw it and run.
